verdict.line: You lose if you trade into her Hallowed Mist poke before level 6; you win once E (Death's Grasp) connects and the fight becomes a stand-still skirmish.

brief.thesis: Gwen's W (Hallowed Mist) makes her untargetable to anyone standing outside the mist, so her entire early trade pattern is poke-from-safety with Q (Snip Snip!) and E (Skip 'n Slash) dashes. The matchup is decided by whether Mordekaiser can force a stand-still fight with E (Death's Grasp) and autos before she resets the mist, which is why OP.GG has Mordekaiser favored for lane and solo kills despite the 50.6% overall win rate across 1,750 games.

theirWindow.when: when her Hallowed Mist is active
theirWindow.what: Do not walk up to trade while she's inside the mist — she can't be targeted unless you step in, and her Q cone/E dash poke will outvalue you for free. Hold position, farm with Q (Obliterate), and wait for the mist to drop (18-22s cooldown by rank).

yourWindow.when: when her E (Skip 'n Slash) dash is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: The moment she dashes to poke without mist up, land E (Death's Grasp) to pull her and go straight into Q plus autos. Her dash is her only reset (11-13s cooldown) — without it she's stuck in melee range for your whole combo.

powerCurve.note: Neither has cooldowns up to punish hard yet
Mist uptime plus Q true damage center outpokes you
R and shorter E/Q cooldowns force stand-still fights
Her rank-3 ult throws needles on an 8.5-8s cooldown

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Mana sustain to keep using Q and E through the poke phase without being starved out by her ranged harassment.

boots.why: Magic resist against an all-magic-damage poke/true-damage kit, and tenacity to shrug off the slow from her R (Needlework).

core.why: The slow on Q and E lets you actually catch her after she burns E (Skip 'n Slash) to disengage.
Sustained damage ramp and true damage conversion win extended stand-still trades once you've pulled her in.
The active dash helps you close the gap before she can reset distance with another E dash.

situational.when: her team has follow-up burst that threatens to kill you during your R all-in window
she's building toward a burst setup and you need more out of your W (Indestructible) shield heal
the game is going long and you need more flat stats to keep scaling

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping adaptive force rewards you for sticking through the poke phase and converts into real damage/healing once the fight becomes a stand-still skirmish.

summoners.why: Ignite punishes her passive (A Thousand Cuts) healing and secures kills once E (Death's Grasp) locks her into range — the 95.7% pick rate and 31.8% win rate on this pairing reflect how often this lane ends in a forced all-in.

playing.title: Don't trade into the mist
playing.detail: If her W (Hallowed Mist) is up, disengage — stepping in to poke her just gives her a free target. Wait out the 18-22s cooldown before pressuring.

playing.title: Punish every E dash commitment
playing.detail: When she uses E (Skip 'n Slash) to poke outside her mist, immediately E (Death's Grasp) her. Her dash is on an 11-13s cooldown and is her only way out of melee range.

playing.title: Stack passive before you commit
playing.detail: Land 3 autos or spells on her first to trigger Darkness Rise's damage aura and move speed before going for the kill — it turns a close trade into a clean one.

playing.title: Respect her Q cone at close range early
playing.detail: Levels 1-2, her Q (Snip Snip!) deals true damage to the center target and applies her healing passive on every snip — don't facetank it while your own cooldowns (8s Q, 16s E at rank 1) are still long.

playing.title: Hold R for isolation, not just damage
playing.detail: Once you hit level 6, use R (Realm of Death) to drag her into a 1v1 when her mist is down rather than mid-poke — it removes outside interference during your all-in window.

playing.title: Use W proactively, not just to survive
playing.detail: Indestructible stores damage dealt and taken — trade autos into her during poke exchanges specifically to build the shield before you commit to the all-in.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, and summoner picks above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.20.1); the trade-pattern reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the kit interactions, not measured data.
